title: Retention, DAU/MAU, and the churn a mobile app really has

videos.script:
Installs are easy to count and easy to celebrate. {{installs}} The question that decides whether the planner works is a different one. Did the people who installed it come back?

Retention answers it, one cohort at a time. {{cohorts}} Everybody who installed in the same week is a cohort, and you follow them week by week. Most leave in the first week. The ones still there after a month tend to stay.

Today you build that table in SQLite, {{table}} with four weekly cohorts, and compute the ratios people quote, DAU over MAU, and see why a study app should quote a different one.

And the churn mobile apps really have. {{churn}} Nobody announces it. People stop opening the app, switch off its notifications, or delete it to free space, and no event is ever sent.
